en: Colorized postcard view of a large, white multi‑story institutional building with many uniform windows, set in front of a wooded hillside. A landscaped park or garden with lawns, trees, and winding footpaths occupies the foreground. To the right is an attached industrial‑looking section with a tall brick smokestack, suggesting a sanatorium, hospital, or factory complex in a semi‑rural setting. There is no visible caption or printed text on the front.
